title: Assembly, Interfaces, Tolerances and Interchangeability
description: Assembly, Interfaces, Tolerances and Interchangeability as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are the installation's physical interfaces with other FDPSs and Systems identified?
Is the build sequence (aircraft Build Station or Bench) proposed for each item?
Are interchangeability or replaceability needs identified?
Is a tolerance stack-up done for each critical interface?
Are datum and location features defined consistently with the mating items?
Can the installation be assembled in the proposed sequence without disturbing other installations?
Are interchangeable items interchangeable at every interface?
Are all interface dimensions and tolerances shown on the released definitions?
Are shimming or fettling allowances defined where tolerance stacks cannot be closed by design?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
